reentry.tipsTitle: Impanuro zivuye ku bantu bakoze ivyo bintu
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Ni igiki cakufashije gutera iyo ntambwe?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Intambwe ya mbere yabaye  ⁇  ikaze i muhira.
reentry.crisisStep: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.resourceOnly: Urutonde rw'ibikoresho gusa  ⁇  Groundwork ntirutanga ivyo canke rukorana n'abatanga.

steps.step3: Gutanguza application ya ID ya Leta
steps.step5: Tegekanya urugendo rwo gusubira i muhira
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step10: Nushire ahabona itariki n'ibisabwa vyo kwinjira ubwa mbere
steps.step13: Niwironkere telefone, ubutumwa bwa e-mail be n'ubuhinga bwa internet ku buntu
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Nuganire n'abajejwe gusubira kwinjira mu gihugu
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Raba aho uruhusha rwawe rw'ukugendesha umuduga ruri
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step23: Gufata umwanya wo kwivuza indwara zo mu mutwe
steps.step24: Gufata ingingo ku bijanye n'ikoreshwa ry'ibiyayuramutwe
steps.step27: Gusaba akazi ku bakoresha baguha akaryo ka kabiri
steps.step29: Niwishingire umugambi wo gukoresha neza amahera yawe
steps.step31: Nusubire kwifatanya n'umuryango wawe, kandi nimba bikenewe ugire ico ukoze ku bijanye n'indishi y'umushahara w'abana
steps.step32: Niwishingire urutonde rw'ivyo ukora buri musi
steps.step33: Niwishingire umugambi w'igihe kirekire maze uhimbaze uwo musi w'intibagirwa

phase3.headline: Umutwe w'inkuru
phase3.interviewHelp: Umutoza wawe aratanga amanota n'agahembo kamwe.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.mentorshipHelp: Nurondere uwukwigisha canke umwereke ko ari we ukwigisha.
phase3.geoHelp: Ibisagara vyawe ni vyo gusa vyigera vyerekanwa abandi.
phase3.rideHelp: Saba uwogutwara, nimero z'amatelefone ntizigenda zirerekanwa.
phase3.partnersHelp: Mu migwi mitomito y'abantu batatu barahana amakuru.
phase3.meetingsTitle: Ibiganiro vyo mu buryo bwa none
phase3.caption: Amajambo y'inyongera
phase3.qaHelp: Nimubaze mutamenyekanye, inyishu ziza ziva ku banywanyi bari kure.
phase3.merchHelp: Nta kintu na kimwe kiri ku mpome kivuga ico bisobanura, kandi nta n'itariki zanditswe.
phase3.shareHelp: Ikarata imwe yerekana ingene uriko uratera imbere irahambaye.
phase3.matchHelp: Umukozi wawe arabanza akaganira n'abandi bamenyeshamakuru.
phase3.override: N'aho biri ukwo, nusabe ijambo ry'intango
phase3.datingOff: Ntituzokwigera dusohokana n'abandi gushika hashingiwe amategeko ajanye n'imisi ntarengwa yo gukundana.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Ahantu ha mbere ho kurondera. Guhitamwo kwinjira, ku rwego rw'igisagara gusa: kuraba uwuriko araja mu nama yawe no guhuza biciye mu butumwa bwo muri porogaramu. Nta nomero za telefone, nta kibanza nyezina.
phase3.groupsHelp: Amashirahamwe yo kwivuza, amashirahamwe yo gushigikira abasubiye kwinjira mu gihugu, hamwe n'amashirahamwe y'ivy'idini n'ay'ikibano hisunzwe igisagara n'umwanya wo guhuriraho.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Bwerekanwa gusa igihe ata muntu n'umwe ari ku rutonde rw'abaja mu nama yawe. Bwerekana ubusabe bwo muri porogaramu  ⁇  ku rwego rw'igisagara gusa, nta nomero za telefone.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Nta muntu n'umwe azoja muri iryo koraniro, akaba ari co gituma Urakeneye uwumwunguruza yerekanwa nk'uwumufasha.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Abashoferi bemerewe gusa. Pings zigenda imwe ku yindi n'umwanya w'iminota 2; uremeza imbere y'uko ikiganiro gikurikira gitangazwa.
phase3.pingConfirm: Kwemeza imbere yo guhamagara ubugira kabiri
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.calcResult: amezi kugira ngo ushike ku mugambi wawe
phase3.musicHelp: Amasanamu y'amasanamu gusa. Nta mahera yo guhanahana amakuru. Umukinnyi arazimya ibiri mw'ishure n'ibice vy'ivyigwa.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Mu gihe uri mu cigwa, umuziki urazimye.
phase3.shareWho: Muri iki gihe: ni wewe wenyene. Gukora urupapuro rwerekana amakuru biratuma uwo ari we wese afise urwo rupapuro ashobora kurusoma.
phase3.suggestHelp: Impanuro gusa  ⁇  nta kintu na kimwe gisohoka utarinze kugishiramwo.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Ni wewe wenyene ushobora kubona ubwo butumwa.
